function.name: submit_plan
function.arguments: {"decision": "clarify", "reason": "请求同时指定了两个区域（ERCO 和 CISO），但 study_schema.region_id 只能取单一区域值，且不允许把一条请求拆成两个独立研究。缺失/歧义字段：(1) region_id —— 需明确是 ERCO 还是 CISO 作为单一研究区域，或说明如何合并为单一区域标识；(2) 若确需覆盖两个区域，需说明是否允许拆分为两个独立研究（当前请求明确禁止拆分，故无法执行）。已明确的字段：task_type=upward_reserve_sizing、horizon_minutes=60、cost_reserve=1.0、cost_shortfall=20.0、rolling_window=train_days=730/cal_days=30/test_days=30/rolling_step_days=30。", "study_schema": null, "admissible_variables": ["calendar", "cost_ratio", "current_load", "horizon", "lagged_load", "load_statistics", "observed_weather", "recent_ramp", "region_id"], "forbidden_variables": ["fabricated_result", "future_load", "future_weather", "raw_data_modification", "realized_target", "test_period_residual"], "workflow": [], "evidence_trace": [], "explanation": "该请求在区域维度上存在歧义，无法在不拆分研究的前提下映射为单一 region_id，因此返回 clarify。所有数值结果（备用容量、平均成本、覆盖率、置信区间、bootstrap 结论、调度结果）只能由已验证的数值工作流计算，本知识层不生成任何此类数值。若后续澄清为单一区域，将按 upward_reserve_sizing、horizon_minutes=60、cost_reserve=1.0、cost_shortfall=20.0、滚动窗口 train_days=730/cal_days=30/test_days=30/rolling_step_days=30 构建方案，并保留 requires_human_approval=true。", "audit_log": {"triggered_rules": ["clarification_required", "single_region_required", "no_request_splitting"], "human_approval_required": true}, "numerical_output_policy": "computed_by_verified_workflow_only"}
